content.text: {"answer":"Tier 1","citations":["D033","D061","D042","D002","D115"],"explanation":"The signed Affiliate Amendment (D033) moved Marrow Agrisupply to Tier 1 effective 2025-10-15, and the 2026 renewal (D042) expressly left its SLA as set by that amendment.
